description:
Remove a video from one of your playlists, every time it appears. The video itself is not affected.

YouTube can't look up entries of a deleted video, so for a deleted or unknown video the whole playlist is read:
1 more unit per 50 entries.

Quota: 51 units.

my_channel.description: Which of your logged-in channels to work on: UC… ID, @handle or exact title. Omit for the default channel.

removed.description: How many occurrences were removed; 0 if the video wasn't in the playlist.
